description.p: Run animated, interactive ASCII artwork as a live desktop wallpaper. A small native engine draws it on the GPU at a fraction of a web view's power and memory.

Port any picture, GIF or video (or a post on X) into an ASCII wallpaper that reacts to the pointer, and give any wallpaper one of 38 styles in one click: LEGO bricks, pixel art, voxel cubes, CRT glass, Game Boy, CMYK print, Matrix code. Fine-tune shapes, palettes, dithering and effects live, and share a look as one line of text. Write your own as a GLSL shader or as HTML, and export them for Wallpaper Engine, Lively Wallpaper and Plash on Windows and macOS.

Discover: 27 ready-made wallpapers in six packs (Calm, Retro, Neon, Print and paper, Hacker, Toys). Choose how each wallpaper answers your pointer: glow, magnify, push away, pull in, swirl or ripple. Simpler settings, with the essentials first. Switching back to characters after a grid style no longer looks zoomed in. A native Mac app as a preview.

A Speed control for every wallpaper: slow any scene down for a calm desktop. One Studio and one portable project file across Windows, Linux, Android, iPhone, iPad and Mac. Android runs the original Fluid, Flow, Matrix and Yin-yang scenes and plays your own pictures, GIFs and videos. Fixes for media types, tall images and editor previews.

38 one-click styles (LEGO, pixel art, voxel, LED, CMYK print, Game Boy, CRT, Matrix code, vaporwave and more), with shapes, 21 character sets, 20 palettes, dithering, stackable effects and animated warps. Share a look as one line of text; PNG renders carry it. Big text wallpapers. Export from the Windows app too. A built-in MCP server lets AI agents design wallpapers.

asciipaper for Windows. Seven new built-in wallpapers (donut, tunnel, starfield, fire, ocean, synthwave, plasma), added as plain files. Yin-yang now reacts like liquid. Click effects and the hover lens are off by default. Fixes: customizing a ported wallpaper could blank it; the Studio could draw a second wallpaper on top of the service.
Native engine for the built-in presets, porting pictures, GIFs and videos, wallpaper specs, a new Studio, and one export for Windows and macOS.
